# Pull Request Rules

## General

- The PR title needs to be clear and human-readable.
- Small incremental patches are better than gigantic code submissions. Huge changes need to be discussed with the RetroDECK Team via our social channels.
- We currently don't accept submissions to our little ES-DE fork. All ES-DE changes should happen upstream just submit your ideas to ES-DE's GitLab. 
    - This is a general recomendation if an improvement can go directly to an component upstream, that's always the preferred path. 

## LLM Rules

- Fully automated PRs through external agents are prohibited.
- We currently do not accept co-authored PRs written by AI.
- You may use an LLM as a light writing assistant to help write the explination of the PR to:
    - Overcome language barriers.
    - Correct grammar, spelling, punctuation, sentence structure and capitalisation.
    - Communicate more effectively, for example: by helping you with markdown formatting.
- **Most importantly:** You need to understand the code you are submitting. 
    - Please remember that the RetroDECK Team needs to understand it too, so be prepared to explain in your own words why this PR is needed and what you hope to achieve. You may be asked about the full PR or just specific sections and you should be able to explain whichever comes up.
